data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2020 was $47.035m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a modest favourable prior-year development (release) of approximately $2.17m (4.6% of opening reserves), driven primarily by improvements on the 2018 underwriting year. The report also notes a net deterioration of $5.407m in prior year reserves on a net-of-reinsurance basis; however the gross triangle analysis (preferred) shows a small release. The reserve movements and adverse / favourable developments were driven by natural catastrophe activity in 2018-2019 and subsequent re-estimation of those events together with reinsurance recovery experience.

We are disappointed with the 2018 closed year result. The net loss position for the syndicate for 2018 was a consequence of the frequency of catastrophes, particularly in the last quarter of the year, rather than the severity of any individual event.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 36). The narrative note states a net deterioration of $5.407m (net of reinsurance) which conflicts with the gross triangle-derived release of $2.172m; per extraction rules the gross triangle was used as primary source. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
